🏦 The Reserve Bank has kept the repo rate at 7.25%. Prime stays at 10.75%.

Why: inflation jumped to 5.2% in October, driven by fuel, and the Governor is worried about rising core inflation.

On a R1 million home loan over 20 years, repayments stay at about R10,152 a month. No change, for now.

General information, not financial advice.

Did you expect a hold? 👇
